t: Minecraft's CUTEST Mod Ever?! Alylica's Item Pets Mod Showcase
d:
Meet your new best friends! In this BLOCK FOUNDRY episode, we're diving into Alylica's Item Pets Mod – the adorable Minecraft mod that turns items into living, floating pets!

From a glowing Bee and a tiny Axolotl in a cube, to a Fiery Nether pet, a Slime, an Allay, and even a Clownfish in a bubble – these little companions follow you everywhere and light up your caves!
